name: Adcal-D3 (Calcium Carbonate + Colecalciferol)
mechanism: Provides supplemental calcium (1500mg) and vitamin D3 (400IU) per 2 tablets
contraindications: Hypercalcaemia, hypercalciuria, renal calculi, severe renal impairment
interactions: Bisphosphonates (separate by 2h), levothyroxine (separate by 4h), tetracyclines, iron
monitoring: Serum calcium if long-term use, renal function
pregnancy: Safe - calcium and vitamin D requirements increase in pregnancy
pharmacokinetics: Calcium carbonate requires acid for absorption (take with food)
clinicalPearls: Extremely commonly prescribed in UK. Chewable or dispersible. Take 2h away from bisphosphonates
indication: Osteoporosis prevention/treatment adjunct, vitamin D deficiency, calcium supplementation
